detaileddescription.para: Solakon ONE Monitor - Terminal monitoring tool Reads real-time data from Solakon ONE via Modbus TCP Displays it in a btop-like terminal interface
Usage: solakonOne [IP] [interval N] [once] IP: Solakon ONE IP (default: 192.168.178.121) N: Refresh interval in Hz (default: 1) once: Single snapshot and exit
